title: Moburst reveals AI-powered mobile growth playbook following record campaign performance milestones
excerpt: Moburst publishes its four-pillar mobile growth framework for the AI era, covering ASO, Answer Engine Optimization, AI-mediated paid acquisition, and empirical creative testing. The release follows campaign overachievements of up to 200% with Sprout Social.
content_html:
NEW YORK & TEL AVIV, August 10, 2026

Moburst, a global mobile App marketing agency specializing in creative strategy, performance marketing, and data science, has published its integrated framework for mobile application growth in the AI era. The announcement follows recently published performance metrics with technology partner Sprout Social, demonstrating campaign goal overachievements of up to 200% and a 33% reduction in creator sourcing time across key accounts.

As artificial intelligence shifts how social platforms, search engines, and app stores index and serve content, traditional mobile app growth and marketing models face diminishing returns. Rather than adding disconnected AI copywriting tools to legacy playbooks, Moburst’s approach restructures mobile growth around four core pillars designed for machine evaluation and shortened user acquisition journeys.

Pillar One: App Store Optimization (ASO) for Dual Audiences Modern ASO operates across two layers: human visual scanning and machine indexing. Apple’s automated App Store Tags and Google Play’s Guided Search prioritize inferred intent over exact keyword matching. Moburst’s framework optimizes metadata to serve machine extractions while remaining natural for human user search queries.

Pillar Two: Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) Before navigating to an app store, a growing segment of consumers relies on conversational AI assistants like ChatGPT and Gemini for app recommendations. Moburst integrates AEO across independent web sources, review platforms, and community discussions to establish structured entity authority, ensuring AI engines cite client applications as primary recommendations.

Pillar Three: Shorter, AI-Mediated Paid Acquisition With users arriving pre-qualified through synthesized AI comparisons, paid campaigns shift from top-of-funnel education to direct conversion. Aligning creative assets and bidding strategies with this abbreviated conversion path increases capital efficiency across paid channels.

Pillar Four: Empirical Creative Testing Leveraging AI for the rapid production and iteration of screenshot variants, preview cuts, and iconography, the framework enforces strict testing protocols. Creative iterations are validated using real-time A/B performance data rather than subjective estimates.

“The mobile marketing landscape has moved beyond generic AI adoption claims,” said Julia Salume, Head of Influencer and UGC at Moburst. “Eliminating operational friction and manual workarounds allows our teams to focus on strategic execution. Integrating data integrity across ASO, AEO, paid media, and creative testing delivers measurable scalability without compromising baseline accuracy.”

The practical application of this unified structure was underscored in Moburst’s recent integration of advanced social intelligence and semantic search tooling through Sprout Social. By removing manual keyword filtering and leveraging natural language discovery, the agency expanded campaign handling capacity while saving over 30 hours per week in administrative tasks, directly contributing to cross-channel performance lifts for its global client roster.

About Moburst

Moburst is a full-service global mobile marketing agency focused on helping brands achieve hyper-growth. Specializing in ASO, user acquisition, creative strategy, influencer marketing, and data science, Moburst transforms complex marketing challenges into performance-driven results for Fortune 500 companies and high-growth startups worldwide.

content_html_zh:
纽约和特拉维夫，2026 年 8 月 10 日

Moburst是一家专注于创意策略、绩效营销和数据科学的全球移动应用营销机构，发布了人工智能时代移动应用增长的综合框架。 在此公告之前，技术合作伙伴 Sprout Social 最近发布了绩效指标，显示活动目标超额完成高达 200%，并且跨关键客户的创作者采购时间减少了 33%。

随着人工智能改变社交平台、搜索引擎和应用程序商店索引和服务内容的方式，传统的移动应用程序增长和营销模式面临着回报递减。 Moburst 的方法不是在传统剧本中添加断开连接的人工智能文案工具，而是围绕四个核心支柱重组移动增长，这些核心支柱旨在机器评估和缩短用户获取旅程。

第一支柱：针对双重受众的应用商店优化 (ASO) 现代 ASO 跨两层运行：人类视觉扫描和机器索引。 Apple 的自动 App Store 标签和 Google Play 的引导搜索优先考虑推断意图，而不是精确的关键字匹配。 Moburst 的框架优化了元数据以服务于机器提取，同时保持人类用户搜索查询的自然性。

第二支柱：答案引擎优化 (AEO) 在进入应用商店之前，越来越多的消费者依赖 ChatGPT 和 Gemini 等对话式 AI 助手来进行应用推荐。 Moburst 将 AEO 集成到独立的网络资源、审查平台和社区讨论中，以建立结构化实体权威，确保 AI 引擎引用客户端应用程序作为主要建议。

第三支柱：更短的、人工智能介导的付费获取随着用户通过综合人工智能比较获得资格预审，付费活动从漏斗顶部教育转向直接转化。 将创意资产和出价策略与这种简化的转化路径保持一致，可以提高付费渠道的资本效率。

第四支柱：实证创意测试利用人工智能快速生成和迭代屏幕截图变体、预览剪切和图像，该框架强制执行严格的测试协议。 使用实时 A/B 性能数据而不是主观估计来验证创意迭代。

Moburst 影响者和 UGC 主管 Julia Salume 表示：“移动营销格局已经超越了一般人工智能采用的说法。” “消除运营摩擦和手动解决方法使我们的团队能够专注于战略执行。 将 ASO、AEO、付费媒体和创意测试中的数据完整性集成起来，可在不影响基线准确性的情况下提供可衡量的可扩展性。”

Moburst 最近通过 Sprout Social 整合先进的社交智能和语义搜索工具，强调了这种统一结构的实际应用。 通过取消手动关键字过滤并利用自然语言发现，该机构扩大了营销活动处理能力，同时每周在管理任务上节省了 30 多个小时，直接为其全球客户名册的跨渠道绩效提升做出了贡献。

关于莫伯斯特

Moburst 是一家提供全方位服务的全球移动营销机构，致力于帮助品牌实现高速增长。 Moburst 专注于 ASO、用户获取、创意策略、影响者营销和数据科学，为全球财富 500 强公司和高增长初创公司将复杂的营销挑战转化为绩效驱动的成果。
